items.Sentence: preliminary screening with mechanical bar screens,
New headworks, including new influent pump station, odor control, screening, and grit removal;
When placed into operation, the influent will go through new bar screens and a new grit removal system prior to flowing through to the existing treatment system,
secondary biological treatment with fixed film reactors and aeration basins,
mono- or dual-media filtration (the Discharger occasionally routes flows around these filters when influent flows are high),
Coagulant may be added to the dual media filter flow for recycled water production.
An earth and rip-rap equalization basin owned by the West Bay Sanitary District may be used to reduce force main flows.
Primary sludge is processed using a gravity thickener and rotating drum thickeners, and secondary sludge is processed using gravity belt thickeners.

The thickened sludge is pumped to the anaerobic digestion process. Three primary anaerobic digesters are mechanically mixed and designed to operate at 95 degrees Fahrenheit with a hydraulic retention time of 33 days with three digesters in service.
Ferric chloride is added to the anaerobic digester feed to reduce hydrogen sulfide in the digester gas.
Biosolids are de-watered using polymer conditioning and rotary fan press units.
The solids are transported to concrete lined air-drying beds.
Up to about 40 percent of the solids collected downstream from the fan press units is sent to an onsite biosolids drying process involving pyrolysis to create biochar used for beneficial reuse.
During the wet weather season, solids are conveyed to trucks for disposal.
